title: World Devastators
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: World Devastators, even more deadly than Death Stars, threaten to wreck the New Republic in DARK EMPIRE, a chilling six-part saga from Dark Horse Comics. Cover artist Dave Dorman (front) has been painting covers for 15 years. Series artist Cam Kennedy shows Han and Chewbacca (back) at the rebel stronghold on the fifth moon of Da Soocha.
